title: Amplification query bound
statement: Let $\mathrm{rate},\varepsilon>0$, let $0<\delta\le 1/2$, and let $r$ be a nonnegative integer. If $N=\left\lceil\log(1/\delta)/(\mathrm{rate}\,\varepsilon)\right\rceil$, then $Nr\le \bigl(\log(1/\delta)/(\mathrm{rate}\,\varepsilon)+1\bigr)r$.
